proverb.en: See no evil hear no evil

conversation: Neil Armstrong the American astronaut is talking to a reporter about his journey to the moon.
A: Did you have any problem on the journey?
B: We didn't have any serious problems, but it certainly wasn't a holiday.
B: We didn't have a wash or a shave for 2 weeks.
B: Yes, it wasn't very comfortable.
A: What about food? Was that any problem?
B: Well, we didn't have any normal food.
B: We had some food tablet.
A: Are you going to the moon again?
B: I hope so. It was wonderful.
